methods.description: Find simple and compound interest for the same deposit/rate/term, then subtract.
Compare the intentionally equal first-period interest and balance.
Distinguish constant simple yearly additions from growing compound additions.
Identify straight versus increasingly steep curves and read supplied balance axes.
Calculate both total balances with different rates over the same stated term.
Try whole years for each offer and verify the predecessor before the first compound lead.
Calculate gaps at two terms and divide unrounded gaps for the requested comparison.
Write both balances in terms of the same unknown deposit and solve their stated difference.
Find compound interest, substitute into I=Prn and divide to recover the simple percentage rate.
Check first whole-year lead and subtract unrounded totals for the margin.
Use the preceding balance to find each single year interest, compare with constant simple yearly interest.
